exclusion_detail: Lead 5d (abstract: 'compound 5d being the most active one') is the CuAAC product of 7-propargyloxycoumarin (3, procedure given) and a protected azido-sugar 4d; 4d is only said to be 'readily prepared from commercially available monosaccharides ... reported in the literature [15, 16] (Supporting Information Table S1)', with no procedure in the article, and no SI is in the bundle.

lead.label: 5d
lead.why: Abstract: 'compound 5d being the most active one with zones of inhibition ...'

notes: Every 5a-f needs a literature-prepared azido sugar, so none has an explicit route here. The coumarin half (7-hydroxycoumarin + propargyl bromide) is explicit; the sugar half is not.
